verdict.rationale: Linear provides a documented TypeScript SDK exposing its GraphQL schema with strongly typed models/operations, alongside a public GraphQL API, OAuth2/API key auth, webhooks, and an official MCP server — a solid official developer toolkit for AI-native builders. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the SDK's quality or breadth, and no mention of SDKs beyond TypeScript (e.g., other languages).
